blocks.x: Food processors live on quality, yield and traceability: intake grading, process yield, food-safety evidence and provenance claims. Vision grading, yield analytics and chain-of-custody convert commodity margin into brand margin.

The workflows we industrialize here: Intake grading, Process yield analytics, Lot traceability, Cold-chain monitoring, Provenance claims. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.
